item.title: Why were residents not consulted about such a drastic change to our pavements?!!, 22nd November
item.description:
We should all have had an option to give our views..... WHY WAS THIS NOT DONE? THIS IS SO WRONG. WE LIVE HERE AND SHOULD HAVE HAD A VOICE The tarmac replacement is TOTALLY out of character for the 1940's/1950's housing. it is spoiling the aesthetic appearance of the Gardens and should have had proper paving slab maintenance and replacement where needed. Had this been maintained none of this should be done! These are good paving slabs, as old as the housing and our now wasted! Also there should be an edging/barrier where the verge meets the tarmac. This is crucial for it is liable to crumble and break apart in no time and allow weeds to infiltrate. Due to lack of maintenance over many years there is no longer grass in the verge outside my property. It is predominantly invasive yarrow, dandelion. cats-ear, thistle, barbed fox tail grass (seeds dangerous for dogs) all of which have seeded into my lawn and borders! Operatives bypass the edge all along the side by the lamppost when racing from A to B cutting the verge so yarrow etc will encroach into the tarmac in no time when there is NO BARRIER to stop tarmac breaking and invasive weeds from taking over the path! I have lived in this area all my life and have seen such a sad deterioration and neglect over time This tarmac has noticeably lowered the visual quality of the environment and is most definately A BLOT ON THE LANDSCAPE..... TWO SAYINGS come to mind Dont fix what aint broke AND Spoiing the ship for an ha'porth o tar
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 67, Brooklyn Gardens, Kingsditch, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Abandoned recycling boxes, 22nd November
item.description:
There are multiple broken and abandoned recycling boxes and food caddies on Normal Terrace, approximately opposite numbers 7/8. These have been building up for a few years up and down the street and I have collected them together there over time to try and keep them out the way. Would it be possible for someone to come and collect them? We use all of the full size bins with the red, yellow and blue tops, it's just the smaller ones that aren't in use. If the pieces of fence that have also been dumped there at some point could also be removed that would be great.
